description.value: The Granville Island Stage is one of three professional venues operated by the Arts Club Theatre Company, one of Canada's largest not-for-profit theatre companies, founded in 1964 and welcoming over a quarter million guests annually. It presents a full season of dramas, musicals, and new works in the heart of Granville Island, one of Vancouver's most popular urban cycling destinations. A touring cyclist riding the seawall or exploring the island can easily combine a visit here with the market, galleries, and waterfront that make Granville Island a standout stop.

enrichment_extras.notes: The Arts Club Theatre Company operates three Vancouver venues; this record covers only the Granville Island Stage at 1585 Johnston St. Other Arts Club venues (Goldcorp Stage / BMO Theatre Centre, Stanley Industrial Alliance Stage) are separate OSM records and should not be merged with this listing.
